item.text: The four seed datasets are present and healthy. The Jackdaw table has repeated sample-level rows per site, so I’ll treat a CpG site as a unique genomic position (chromosome plus position) and compute per-chromosome site count divided by the supplied chromosome length. I’m now creating an independent copy of the seed history before any analysis.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import os
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
seed='bbd44e69cb8906b55fe8d7fc8d3dc061'
key_path=os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']
with open(key_path) as fh:
    key=fh.read().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', key=key)
name='Codex copy: Which chromosome in the Jackdaw genome shows the highest density of age-related CpG sites?'
res=gi.histories.copy_history(seed, name=name, all_datasets=True)
print(res.get('id'))
print(res.get('name'))
PY"
